subject: Managed Steam game-server backend-state evidence
method: Read-only dnlib metadata and IL inspection; game assemblies were not loaded or executed.
scopeLimit: These are local original assembly snapshots. They do not establish the remote server's exact binaries, loaded extensions, or current Steam backend state.

interfaceValid.implementation: SteamInterface.get_IsValid, token 06000B29, IL0000-0010 compares native Self with IntPtr.Zero.
interfaceValid.meaning: A nonzero native interface pointer; not evidence of current Steam backend login.

backendLoggedOn.runtimeValue: Not observed. A future diagnostic must guard interface availability before reading this getter.

countReporting.implementation: Gates on SteamServer.IsValid, reads activePlayerList.Count at IL01A1-01A6, emits cp and sets GameTags at IL022A; no LoggedOn gate identified.
countReporting.limit: Changing cp, query counts, or local player rows does not directly measure current Steam backend login or Facepunch per-account inclusion.

builtInDiagnosticScan.scope: ConsoleGen command registrations and direct SteamServer getter references in Assembly-CSharp.dll; steamstatus implementation in Facepunch.SteamNetworking.dll.
builtInDiagnosticScan.result: No built-in command exposing SteamServer.LoggedOn was identified in this snapshot.

steamstatus.limit: Reports networking identity, fake-address result, and Datagram Relay availability; does not read SteamServer.IsValid or LoggedOn. Raw output may contain identity and address data.

startupAndReconnect.startup: SteamPlatform.StartSteamServer, token 06000046: Init at IL00A8, callback registration at IL00D7-0105, LogOnAnonymous at IL0120.
startupAndReconnect.advertising: SteamServer.Init, token 06000990, enables advertising at IL0163-0164. AdvertiseServer and AutomaticHeartbeats setters both call native SetAdvertiseServerActive; no advertising-state getter was identified.
startupAndReconnect.connectedHandler: SteamPlatform.OnSteamConnected, token 06000048: constant message, Debug.Log, return.
startupAndReconnect.disconnectedHandler: SteamPlatform.OnSteamServersDisconnected, token 06000047: format result, Debug.LogWarning, return.
startupAndReconnect.managedReplay: No replay of active UpdatePlayerSession calls was identified in these managed reconnect handlers.
startupAndReconnect.nativeReconnectBehavior: Unknown. Log-only managed handlers do not prove that native Steam loses or restores active users.
startupAndReconnect.forceHeartbeat: SteamServer.ForceHeartbeat, token 060009B0, contains only ret in this snapshot.

playerReporting.path: Auth_Steam success -> SteamPlatform.UpdatePlayerSession -> SteamServer.UpdatePlayer -> native BUpdateUserData.
playerReporting.nativeResult: SteamServer.UpdatePlayer, token 060009B1, calls BUpdateUserData at IL0008 and discards its Boolean result at IL000D.
playerReporting.resultLimit: No actual native result was observed. It cannot be queried retrospectively through this wrapper; calling BUpdateUserData again would change state.
playerReporting.gates: No sleeping-state, first-PlayerTick, or per-player EAC gate was identified inside this managed Steam reporting path. EAC admission is a separate stage.
playerReporting.eligibilityLimit: Successful Steam ticket authentication and matched Steam authentication counts do not establish Facepunch account eligibility or a valid protected EAC session.

remainingEvidence: Read interface-valid and guarded backend-logged-on values through an explicitly deployed diagnostic when deployment is available.
Passively observe existing connected/disconnected event categories without publishing identifiers.
Observe the original BUpdateUserData result during a future authorized authentication; do not issue extra update calls as a query.
Keep backend login, Steam user reporting, Facepunch account inclusion, and EAC state as separate observations.
actionsPerformed: Static local inspection and this sanitized report only; no network requests, session changes, configuration changes, or diagnostic deployment.
